gaps.where: A lead (side sheet, full page and phone lead page): the ⋯ menu item “Delete for good…” (BIN_WORDS.menu); phone: the “Delete for good…” button
gaps.gap: The places map tells the Assistant a lead can't be deleted, though the screens and its own tool can. The lead place's ⋯ line lists only Edit details and Archive lead. Its notHere says 'deleting a lead (archive it)', and NOT_ANYWHERE says 'deleting a company or lead for good (they are archived…)'. The lead's ⋯ has Delete for good… for people with records.archive + records.delete, and the phone lead page has the button. move_to_bin's own description says it deletes leads and companies. 'How do I delete this lead?' gets 'HandsFreeOS doesn't do that', which contradicts move_to_bin.
gaps.fix: packages/core/src/assistant/places-map.ts: line 224 → 'Note, Log call, Won and Lost (Reopen once closed); ⋯ has Edit details, Archive lead and Delete for good… (owners)'. Line 235: drop notHere 'deleting a lead (archive it)'. Add howTo 'Delete it for good: ⋯, then Delete for good… (owners); it waits 30 days in Settings → Deleted bin'. Line 616: rewrite to drop 'company or lead' (e.g. remove the entry, or make it 'deleting anything at once with no way back: what is deleted for good waits 30 days in Settings → Deleted bin').

gaps.where: A lead (side sheet and full page): Next: … · due time, Lost: reason · date, Won · date, Value, Assigned to, Last contact, Expected close, Source, Tags, “N days in stage”, Archived, Qualification card
gaps.gap: get_lead, list_leads and get_customer's openLeads all go through leadResult. It keeps only id, title, customer, personId, stage, status, value, assignee, nextAction, needsNextAction and createdAt. It drops nextActionAt, nextActionOverdue, lostReason, lostAt, wonAt, expectedCloseOn, source, tags, lastContactAt, stageEnteredAt, archivedAt and company (when there is also a person). get_lead also drops lead.qualification, which lead.get returns. The only partial fallback is read_lead_board, which returns raw LeadCards. It is unreliable: cut at 16,000 chars, no archived leads, no qualification.
gaps.fix: apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-read.ts: extend the LeadItem interface (:136) and leadResult (:210) with nextActionAt (when()), nextActionOverdue, lostReason, lostAt/wonAt (when()), expectedCloseOn, source, tags (names), lastContactAt (when()), daysInStage (from stageEnteredAt), company name, and archived (bool). In get_lead (:376) also return qualification {status, answers: question → quoted(answer), missing}. Update the get_lead description in packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts:105 to name these fields.

gaps.where: Pipeline header “N open leads · $X” and the board/list of leads
gaps.gap: Totals are reachable: read_crm_summary (crm.summary) gives open-lead count and value for the business, and read_lead_board gives per-stage counts. So 'how many open leads' is answerable. What is real: list_leads reports `count: items.length` (max 20), which reads like a total. It drops lead.list's nextCursor, so nobody knows more exist. It can't filter by pipelineId, companyId or q, though lead.list takes them. Its description says 'newest first', while lead.list sorts by last change (updatedAt desc).

Change the description to 'Leads, most recently changed first… for totals use read_crm_summary or read_lead_board'. apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-read.ts:349-360: pass them through, return {shown: items.length, nextCursor, more: !!nextCursor} instead of count.

gaps.where: Approvals (phone More → Approvals; web Workflows → Approvals): a workflow approval’s card — the AI-written text (“The text that will go · You can edit”), “Latest message from …”, Knowledge used, who was asked and how long it waited, Expires in …
gaps.gap: No tool returns what the AI wrote in a waiting workflow approval. The context lists at most 10 pending approvals (no 'of N') with only workflow, customer and 'a text/an email/the next step'. answer_workflow_approval puts the text on the person's card, but its result gives the model none of it. A 'say Wednesday instead' edit rewrites a text the model never saw. what_needs_attention doesn't help: attention's previewText reads the top-level 'message' key (the approval step's note) and never 'fields', so its detail.draft is the note, not the AI text. The worker's approval-words copy also drops asked, items, expiresAt and approvers. Prepare offers Approve on an approval past expiresAt, which the command then refuses (approval_expired).

gaps.where: New task / Edit task dialog: Due, with “At a specific time” unticked by default (all-day)

The field has no description, and dueAt must be a full date-time. 'Due Friday' typically becomes a timed task at 00:00 or 09:00, overdue from that moment.
